hero.description: A cat-eye acetate frame drawn from Parisian afternoons — designed for women who spend the day between screens and softer light.

features.title: Cat-eye, softened
features.body: Warm tortoise acetate cut in a rounded cat-eye — feminine but never loud.

features.title: Screen-honest color
features.body: EyegisGuard™ filters the harmful HEV band without an amber tint or color shift.

features.title: All-day balance
features.body: 19.4g on the face with gold-tone spring hinges tuned for a soft, secure fit.

detail.title: EyegisGuard™
detail.body: A precisely tuned coating that attenuates the 400–455 nm band of high-energy visible light — without shifting natural colors. No amber tint. No compromise.
